identity.name: Stafford Reservoir
identity.summary: Western Chin Coulee reservoir east of Lethbridge. Open-water kite spot (including ice-edge sessions). OSM maps this basin as part of Chin Lakes; chop keeps it separate from the AGS Chin Lakes DEM. Depth is a shore-distance fill.

geometry.notes: Irrigation reservoir in Chin Coulee. Confirm access; adjacent to Chin Lakes further east.
